mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park at 40 degrees, and with the waning gibbous moon out, we expect an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

Important news for local elections: the City of Verona has made candidate packets available for the 2027 election, and all forms must be submitted to the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street by 5 PM on January 5, 2027.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run today, the Crafty Fair and live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow, and yoga classes starting November 30.
Looking at the weekly report, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash where a driver was arrested for O W I with a minor child in the vehicle.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day; they are currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight.
